lessons.ponglish: pl-only lesson (profile pl.md §8 'add' / §4.4 / §9): Ponglish traps — false friends (aktualny/current, ewentualnie/possibly, sympatyczny/nice, pensja/salary, recepta/prescription, fabryka/factory, dres/tracksuit, magazyn/warehouse, sałata/lettuce, ordynarny/rude), one Polish word vs two English words (robić: do/make, pożyczyć: borrow/lend, uczyć się/uczyć: learn/study/teach), calques (mam 20 lat, dziś rano, z góry dziękuję, interested/bored, advices) and it for objects; placed after smalltalk via profile.json lessonOrder.after; deck „Fałszywi przyjaciele i kalki”; replaces the ko-only konglish slot, no ko-en counterpart (mirrors zh chinglish / ru runglish). English side starts from ru runglish (She works at a factory, Can I give you some advice?, I need some advice, make coffee, My phone is old. It doesn't work.) with the Russian-only items replaced by Polish ones as profile §8 lists (prescription/receipt, warehouse/magazine, current/actual, lend/borrow, I'm twenty years old, interested in history, made a mistake); its practice set meets the article-plural rule on its own (order 4/4, type 3/4)
lessons.articles-3: pl-only lesson (profile pl.md §8 add, §4.1): „Przedimki: powtórka i podsumowanie” — articles revisited at B1. Body leads with omission, the main Polish error (missing the 37% + missing a 18% of article errors, Rozovskaya & Roth 2010): a / an before a singular count noun even with a description (an engineer who…, an interesting article), the for a noun defined by a phrase or clause, for the one in the room and with superlatives (the music in this cafe, the coffee you made, Can you open the window?, the best movie); then the shorter half on withholding it: generic plurals, uncountable and abstract nouns (Cats sleep a lot, Time is money, Life is short), city names, zero-article fixed phrases (go to bed, go to work / school, at home / work, by train / bus). English side (check and practice) copied verbatim from ru articles-3 (itself ja's set) as profile §8 says, with one localisation per profile §9: Moscow → Warsaw in the engineer mc item (all four options) and the matching body row. Replaces the Korean course's own articles-3 (ko ownLessons), which the scaffold copied. Placed after passive via profile.json lessonOrder.after; deck „Pogawędki” (deck 10, as ru and zh). The optional swap of two zero-article items for omission items (profile §8, the lead's call) was not made.
